name: Lawrence (Massachusetts, United States)
description: Blue field with three white stripes for the Spicket, Merrimack and Shawsheen Rivers: one horizontal from the hoist, the others diverging from it diagonally towards the upper and lower fly.
history: Lawrence is a city located in Essex County, Massachusetts, on the Merrimack River. The flag was adopted in 1903 (designed by Daniel W. Hoff and first flown on 1 June 1903, the fiftieth anniversary of the city's incorporation, according to Flags of the World citing the Lawrence Historical Commission).

features.role: three stripes representing the Spicket, Merrimack and Shawsheen Rivers and their courses
